description: Central bank policy rates from each bank's own data feed: Fed, ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Canada, Riksbank, Norges Bank, Danmarks Nationalbank and Banco Central do Brasil. Per bank: current rate, last change (date, from, to, bps), 12-month change and stance (hiking, cutting, on hold). Plus an FX carry ranking against a funding currency: rate differential, spot and 1-month spot move from ECB reference rates. Refreshed hourly. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

currency.description: Comma-separated subset: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, SEK, NOK, DKK, BRL (default all)

funder.description: Funding currency for the carry ranking (default: the lowest-rate currency)

name: central_bank_rates
